name: Secureframe
description: Secureframe is a security compliance automation platform for frameworks, controls, tests, evidence, personnel compliance, policies, training, risk, vendors, access reviews, questionnaires, and audit readiness.
agentUseSummary: Add customer-owned credentials for a dedicated RBAC-restricted user and bind the US or UK region. Selected agents can list only bounded, minimized compliance framework metadata. Relay blocks evidence, personnel, audits, search, exports, and every mutation.

credentialRequirements.name: SECUREFRAME_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Secureframe region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter us or uk to bind the connector to Secureframe's documented regional API origin.

credentialRequirements.name: SECUREFRAME_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Secureframe API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: API key assigned to a dedicated custom role that can only read frameworks.

credentialRequirements.name: SECUREFRAME_API_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Secureframe API secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: One-time-visible API secret stored encrypted and sent only in the regional API Authorization header.

capabilities.label: Read compliance frameworks
capabilities.description: List a bounded, minimized directory of frameworks visible to a dedicated RBAC-restricted API user.

allowed.label: List compliance frameworks
allowed.description: List up to 20 minimized framework records from the bound Secureframe company.

blocked.label: Access compliance evidence or change Secureframe
blocked.description: Evidence, controls, tests, requirements, personnel, policies, training, risks, vendors, questionnaires, integrations, audit logs, search, exports, custom data, and every mutation are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One bounded framework-directory read runs directly; evidence, personnel, audit, search, exports, and all mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway binds one documented regional origin and exposes only a bounded framework directory.
Railway binds one documented regional origin and exposes only a bounded framework directory.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer has supplied a key and one-time-visible secret for a dedicated custom-role user restricted to framework reads, and non-production lifecycle acceptance has not been completed.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Secureframe Super Admin creates a dedicated user and custom role with only framework-read authority, creates the API key/secret, records us or uk, stores all values through Relay's encrypted credential flow, then validates bounded reads, RBAC denial, rotation/revocation, disconnect, rate limiting, and post-disconnect denial in non-production.

evidence.supports: Secureframe documents customer REST APIs, per-company/user key and secret authentication, RBAC authorization, JSON:API responses, dated versioning, 500 requests per minute, framework reads, and extensive sensitive and mutating resources.

Secureframe documents Super Admin key creation, one-time-visible secrets, key-plus-secret Authorization, US and UK API origins, 100-record server pagination limits, evidence and test use cases, and broad management APIs.
Secureframe confirms RBAC-bound API credentials, request auditing, customer-plan access, rate limits, and read/archive vendor operations.
